6	/**
7	 * Core JWT engine bound to a resolved config.

9	 */
10	export interface JwtEngine {
11	  /**
12	   * Generates a signed access token.
13	   * @param payload - The user claims to embed.
14	   */
15	  generateAccessToken(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<string>;
16	
17	  /**
18	   * Generates a signed refresh token.
19	   * @param payload - The user claims to embed.
20	   */
21	  generateRefreshToken(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<string>;
22	
23	  /**
24	   * Generates both an access and refresh token in parallel.
25	   * @param payload - The user claims to embed.
26	   */
27	  generateTokenPair(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<TokenPair>;
28	
29	  /**
30	   * Verifies an access token and returns the decoded payload.
31	   * @throws {AuthError} on invalid, expired, or malformed tokens.
32	   */
33	  verifyAccessToken(token: string): Promise<AuthUser>;
34	
35	  /**
36	   * Verifies a refresh token and returns the decoded payload.
37	   * @throws {AuthError} on invalid, expired, or malformed tokens.
38	   */
39	  verifyRefreshToken(token: string): Promise<AuthUser>;
40	
41	  /**
42	   * Decodes a token without verifying the signature.
43	   * ⚠️ Use only for non-security-sensitive inspection.
44	   */
45	  decodeToken(token: string): AuthUser;
46	}

48	/**
49	 * Creates a JWT engine bound to the given resolved config.
50	 */
51	export function createJwtEngine(config: ResolvedConfig): JwtEngine {
52	  return {
53	    generateAccessToken(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<string> {
54	      return signToken(payload, config.accessSecret, config.accessExpiresIn);
55	    },
56	
57	    generateRefreshToken(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<string> {
58	      return signToken(payload, config.refreshSecret, config.refreshExpiresIn);
59	    },
60	
61	    async generateTokenPair(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<TokenPair> {
62	      const [accessToken, refreshToken] = await Promise.all([
63	        signToken(payload, config.accessSecret, config.accessExpiresIn),
64	        signToken(payload, config.refreshSecret, config.refreshExpiresIn),
65	      ]);
66	      return { accessToken, refreshToken };

1	import { SignJWT } from "jose";
2	import type { JwtPayload } from "../types/auth.js";
3	import { parseExpiryToSeconds } from "../utils/helpers.js";
4	
5	/**
6	 * Signs a JWT using HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) with the provided secret.
7	 *
8	 * @param payload - Application-level claims to embed.
9	 * @param secret - Signing secret (UTF-8 string).
10	 * @param expiresIn - Expiry string in zeit/ms format (e.g. "15m", "7d").
11	 * @returns A compact JWT string.
12	 */
13	export async function signToken(
14	  payload: JwtPayload,
15	  secret: string,
16	  expiresIn: string
17	): Promise<string> {
18	  const secretKey = new TextEncoder().encode(secret);
19	
20	  const jwt = await new SignJWT({ ...payload })
21	    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256", typ: "JWT" })
22	    .setIssuedAt()
23	      .setExpirationTime(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + parseExpiryToSeconds(expiresIn))
24	    .setJti(generateJti())
25	    .sign(secretKey);
26	
27	  return jwt;
28	}
29	
30	// ─── Internal Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
31	
32	/**
33	 * Generates a random JWT ID (jti) claim for token uniqueness.
34	 * Uses `crypto.randomUUID` (available in Node.js >= 14.17).
35	 */
36	function generateJti(): string {
37	  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
38	    return crypto.randomUUID();
39	  }
40	  // Fallback for older environments.
41	  return `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
42	}

2	import type { AuthUser } from "../types/auth.js";
3	import { AuthError } from "../errors/authErrors.js";
4	
5	/**
6	 * Verifies a JWT using HS256 and returns the decoded payload.
7	 *
8	 * @param token - The compact JWT string to verify.
9	 * @param secret - The signing secret.
10	 * @returns The decoded `AuthUser` payload.
11	 * @throws {AuthError} with the appropriate code on any verification failure.
12	 */
13	export async function verifyToken(token: string, secret: string): Promise<AuthUser> {
14	  const secretKey = new TextEncoder().encode(secret);
15	
16	  try {
17	    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, secretKey, {
18	      algorithms: ["HS256"],
19	    });
20	
21	    // Ensure the `id` claim is present (required by JwtPayload).
22	    if (typeof payload["id"] !== "string") {
23	      throw new AuthError("AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID", "Token payload is missing the required `id` claim.");
24	    }
25	
26	    return payload as AuthUser;
27	  } catch (err) {
28	    if (err instanceof AuthError) throw err;
29	
30	    // jose may throw platform-specific error classes; fall back to checking `name`.
31	    const errName = (err as any)?.name;
32	
33	    if (err instanceof joseErrors.JWTExpired || errName === "JWTExpired" || errName === "TokenExpiredError") {
34	      throw new AuthError("AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED");
35	    }
36	
37	    if (
38	      err instanceof joseErrors.JWTInvalid ||
39	      err instanceof joseErrors.JWSInvalid ||
40	      err instanceof joseErrors.JWSSignatureVerificationFailed ||
41	      errName === "JWTInvalid" ||
42	      errName === "JWSInvalid" ||
43	      errName === "JWSSignatureVerificationFailed"
44	    ) {
45	      throw new AuthError("AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID");
46	    }
47	
48	    // Any other jose error is treated as invalid.
49	    throw new AuthError("AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID", "Token verification failed.");
50	  }
51	}

4	/**
5	 * Extracts a Bearer token from the `Authorization` header.
6	 * Returns `null` if the header is absent or not a Bearer token.
7	 */
8	function fromAuthorizationHeader(req: Request): string | null {
9	  const authHeader = req.headers["authorization"];
10	  if (!authHeader || typeof authHeader !== "string") return null;
11	
12	  const [scheme, token] = authHeader.split(" ");
13	  if (scheme?.toLowerCase() !== "bearer" || !token) return null;
14	
15	  return token;
16	}
17	
18	/**
19	 * Extracts a token from a named cookie.
20	 * Returns `null` if the cookie is absent.
21	 *
22	 * Works with both the raw `Cookie` header parser and `req.cookies`
23	 * (if cookie-parser is installed).
24	 */
25	function fromCookie(req: Request, cookieName: string): string | null {
26	  // If cookie-parser is installed, use req.cookies directly.
27	  // We cast through unknown to avoid importing cookie-parser types as a hard dependency.
28	  const reqWithCookies = req as unknown as { cookies?: Record<string, string> };
29	  if (reqWithCookies.cookies && typeof reqWithCookies.cookies[cookieName] === "string") {
30	    return reqWithCookies.cookies[cookieName] ?? null;
31	  }
32	
33	  // Fallback: parse the raw Cookie header manually.
34	  const cookieHeader = req.headers["cookie"];
35	  if (!cookieHeader) return null;
36	
37	  return parseCookieHeader(cookieHeader)[cookieName] ?? null;
38	}
39	
40	/**
41	 * Extracts a Bearer token from either:
42	 * 1. The `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (preferred), or
43	 * 2. A named cookie (fallback, requires `cookieName` to be set in config).
44	 *
45	 * Returns `null` if no token is found.
46	 */
47	export function extractToken(req: Request, cookieName?: string): string | null {
48	  return fromAuthorizationHeader(req) ?? (cookieName ? fromCookie(req, cookieName) : null);
